changes: Changes vs kit8p (codex_svc_sml_native@43652e29c252), each tied to a measured kit8p problem:
1. outline 174.96 -> 164.16 (fill ~31% -> ~36%); pins keep their face and order, 1.056 um pitch.
2. reset pad M5_VERTICAL 0.024x0.192 (kit8p DRC 5 came from the horizontal M5 reset pad, RECTONLY/EOL).
3. rr1 (883 async-reset loads, bbox 328.5 um) -> 8 same-edge kept copies of rr1, each feeding one
placement-local group (exp Horner pairs, valid lines, input datapath, control). D of every copy is rr0,
so every copy equals rr1 on every edge: +0 reset cycles, +0 data cycles, 64-low width unchanged.
4. kit opts in OT_F4_PAIR=1 (existing supported F4 option): each zero-logic capture shares its launch flop's
clock leaf (kit8p: 158 internal FF holds -6.40 ps, all zero-logic shift pairs, 26 ps pair skew).
